name: Catalyst Gen AI
tagline: The AI engineering society that builds what it studies.
description: Catalyst Gen AI is the college's AI engineering society. We read papers, rebuild them from scratch, and ship working projects every month.

recruiting.note: Applications for the 2026–27 cohort are closed.

hero.lede: We read the papers on Monday, rebuild them by Friday, and ship something people can use by the end of the month.

prompts.prompt: What does Catalyst Gen AI actually do?
prompts.completion: We pick one idea from current AI research every few weeks, rebuild it from an empty notebook, and turn the best rebuilds into projects with real users. Bring curiosity; we bring the GPUs.
Every token asks every other token how much it matters right now, and those answers decide what the model pays attention to next.

prompts.prompt: Can I join if I've never trained a model?
prompts.completion: Yes. Most of us hadn't either. Our first workshop takes you from an empty notebook to a fine-tuned model in a single evening.

manifesto.statement: AI research moves faster than any syllabus. We close the gap the only way that works: every idea we study ends up as code that someone else can run.
paragraphs: Catalyst Gen AI started as a reading group that kept getting distracted by implementation. That turned out to be the point. Understanding a model properly means watching it fail on your own laptop first.

Today we're a society of builders across every branch and year. Some of us came for the maths, some for the products, and some because a demo night looked like fun. All of us leave able to take a paper, a dataset or a vague idea and turn it into something that works.

loop.title: Read
loop.body: A weekly session picks one paper or technique worth understanding properly, and someone teaches it on a whiteboard.

loop.title: Reproduce
loop.body: Small teams rebuild it from scratch, notebook first. Breaking things is expected; that's where the understanding comes from.

loop.title: Build
loop.body: The strongest reproductions become projects with a repo, a roadmap and people who rely on them.

loop.title: Demo
loop.body: Every month ends with a demo night open to the whole campus. Then we pick the next paper.

contact.heading: Join Catalyst, or just say hello
contact.body: Students apply here to join the society. Companies, labs and other societies use the same form for collaborations and sponsorship.
perks: GPU credits and lab access for society projects
A mentor from the senior core team in your first semester
Priority seats at every workshop and hackathon
